data.narrative:
Last Energy, a Series C nuclear energy company founded by Bret Kugelmass, has raised $140M+ to date. The nuclear energy sector comprises 11 comparable companies—3 public (OKLO, NNE, SMR) and 8 private including Helion, Valar Atomics, X-Energy, and Nano Nuclear Energy.

Given the nascency of the peer set, a Peer-Median approach proved inapplicable; only one adjacent-stage private comparable exists within the nuclear energy universe, falling short of the three-datapoint threshold required for reliable triangulation. Consequently, valuation rests on Stage-Progression methodology, which applies a typical 1.7x multiplier to the $140M total capital raised proxy, yielding an implied valuation of $238M. This reflects the step-up expected between Series C and subsequent financing rounds.

The analysis supports a valuation range of $202M to $274M, centered on $238M. The median estimate carries material uncertainty given reliance on a single method and the immature comparables set. Key risks to valuation include technology advancement pace within advanced nuclear, regulatory pathway clarity, and capital intensity of commercialization—variables poorly constrained by existing peer data. Investors should treat this range as indicative pending access to management's unit economics and pathway-to-revenue forecasts.
